annotations.title: Download an area's drillholes (CSV or OMF)

description: The 3D drillhole view's download, for a signed-in user: every hole within radius_km (at most 10) of a point, or one hole, as a CSV set (a zip of collars, survey, desurveyed path, assays and lithology, with a README) or as one OMF file for Leapfrog, Deswik, Micromine and other 3D packages. Positions are lon/lat and MGA; assays in ppm. Returns a download link (it expires), the file name, its size, how many holes it holds and how many were left out (a file holds the best-documented holes first). The same intervals as JSON, without sign-in: get_drillhole_traces.

hole.description: One hole's id (the 3D view's id, from get_drillhole_traces or best_intercepts).

name.description: The file's name (default: the place and radius).

name: download_drillholes
